python: >=3.11 for the pinned dependencies; tested with Python 3.12.14

mpmath.purpose: arbitrary-precision hypergeometric, gamma, elliptic, and contact evaluations

sympy.purpose: exact rational telescoping, gamma identities, Jacobians, tail signs, and analytic elliptic/Landen/integration-by-parts certificates

matplotlib.purpose: export of the single convergence figure

data_policy: inputs/calculation.json controls numerical settings. inputs/ising2d_exact_data.json is descriptive normalization metadata; constants and conventions are encoded in the scripts. inputs/reference/ contains archived comparison evidence only. All accepted scientific outputs are newly computed by the packaged code.
